title: JFK Assassination Tour with Rooming House and Sixth Floor Museum
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the most complete JFK assassination tour in Dallas, including admission to the renowned Sixth Floor Museum. Led by an Emmy Award-winning investigative journalist and JFK researcher, this immersive experience combines expert storytelling with exclusive multimedia presentations to bring the events of November 22, 1963, to life.

Walk through historic Dealey Plaza, stand where President Kennedy was assassinated, examine the evidence, eyewitness accounts, and enduring mysteries surrounding the case, then continue to the Oswald Rooming House Museum. Step inside the bedroom where Lee Harvey Oswald stayed and retrace his movements following the assassination before exploring the Sixth Floor Museum at your own pace.

Whether you're new to the JFK case or a lifelong student of the assassination, you'll leave with a deeper understanding of one of history's most debated events.

3 hours and 45 minutes (approximately including Sixth Floor Museum)
